title: Reproducible R and Python pipeline: Electroencephalographic criticality and mesoscale–macroscale network decoupling distinguish autism spectrum disorder from neurological disorders: a multi-cohort study
description: Complete refined R scripts (01-05), Python statistical audit, Empirical Bayes ComBat harmonization, REML linear mixed-effects modeling, Fisher z-test stratification, and publication figure generation pipeline supporting the multi-repository qEEG investigation across N = 4,834 EEG recordings (4,609 valid; 2,569 unique biological participants). The accompanying manuscript is currently under peer review and is excluded from this public archive.
